blurb.en: A plain Python list already is a stack: add at the end, take from the end, and look at the end without taking anything.
blurb.zh: 普通的 Python 列表本身就是一个栈：从末尾放、从末尾取、看一眼末尾而不取走。

en: A stack is last in, first out: like a pile of plates, the plate you put down last is the first one you pick up. A list gives you this for free if you only ever work at its end - the end of the list is the top of the stack.

Three operations make up the whole stack. Push puts an item on top; pop takes the top item off and hands it back; peek looks at the top item and leaves it there. The loop at the bottom pushes three plates and pops them all, and they come off in the reverse of the order they went on.

Popping an empty list is an error: Python raises IndexError. The two small functions guard against it the way stack code usually does - check whether the stack is empty first, and hand back None instead. An empty list counts as false, so not stack is true exactly when there is nothing left. The last lines of the demo pop without the guard, catch the error and print only its type.
Exam questions usually build a stack from a fixed-size array and a top pointer instead of a growing list; Stack in an Array with a Top Pointer on this page does it that way.
zh: 栈是后进先出：像一摞盘子，最后放上去的那只最先被拿走。列表只要你始终在它的末尾操作，就白送你一个栈——列表的末尾就是栈顶。
整个栈就三个操作。压栈把一项放到顶上；出栈把顶上那一项拿下来并交回；看栈顶只看一眼，东西留在原处。最下面的循环压进三只盘子再全部弹出，出来的顺序正好与放进去的相反。
对空列表出栈会出错：Python 抛出 IndexError。两个小函数用栈代码的惯常办法防住它——先看栈是不是空的，空就交回 None。空列表算作假，所以栈里一个不剩时 not stack 恰好为真。演示块最后几行故意不设防地出栈，接住这个错误，只打印它的类型名。
考卷上的栈通常不用会长大的列表，而是用定长数组加一个栈顶指针；本页的「定长数组与栈顶指针」就是那样写的。

lineNotes.en: An empty list is falsy, so not stack is True once every plate has been popped.
lineNotes.zh: 空列表为假，所以盘子全部弹完之后 not stack 为 True。

lineNotes.en: Only the name of the exception is printed, not its message: the wording of built-in error messages changes between Python versions.
lineNotes.zh: 只打印异常的类型名、不打印消息：内置异常的措辞会随 Python 版本变。

run.expect:
push red -> ['red']
push green -> ['red', 'green']
push blue -> ['red', 'green', 'blue']
top: blue
pop blue -> ['red', 'green']
pop green -> ['red']
pop red -> []
empty: True
None None
unguarded pop: IndexError

title.en: Stack in an Array with a Top Pointer

blurb.en: The exam-paper stack: an array that never grows, a pointer to the top item, and a clear message on overflow and underflow.
blurb.zh: 考卷上的那种栈：一个不会长大的数组、一个指向栈顶的指针，上溢与下溢各报一句清楚的话。

en: Exam pseudocode usually describes a stack this way: an array of fixed size, and an integer called top that holds the index of the top item. This program is that pseudocode translated line by line, with the array and the pointer kept together in a small class.

top starts at -1, meaning there is nothing in the stack yet. Pushing moves top up one slot and then stores the item there; popping reads the item at top and then moves top down. Getting either order wrong loses an item - it is worth tracing both by hand.

Because the array cannot grow, the stack can be full. Pushing onto a full stack is an overflow and popping an empty one is an underflow; each prints its own message and refuses, instead of crashing. is_full and is_empty are the two tests the pseudocode always has.

After two pops the array still holds every value. Popping never wipes a slot - it only moves top, and anything above top simply no longer counts. The next push overwrites it. A List as a Stack on this page gets the same behaviour from a list that grows and shrinks instead.
zh: 考卷上的伪代码通常这样描述栈：一个定长数组，加一个叫 top 的整数，存着栈顶那一项的下标。本程序就是把那段伪代码逐行翻成 Python，数组与指针放在一个小类里。
top 从 -1 开始，意思是栈里还什么都没有。压栈先把 top 往上挪一格、再把东西存进那一格；出栈先读出 top 那一格、再把 top 往下挪。哪个顺序弄反都会丢掉一项——值得用手各走一遍。
数组不会长大，所以栈会满。往满栈上压是上溢，从空栈里弹是下溢；两种情况各打印自己的一句话并拒绝执行，而不是让程序崩掉。is_full 与 is_empty 是伪代码里总会有的两个判断。
弹出两次之后，数组里的值一个都没少。出栈从不擦掉哪一格——它只挪动 top，top 上面的东西就不再算数，下一次压栈会把它覆盖。本页的「列表当栈」用一个会伸缩的列表做到同样的事。

lineNotes.en: Minus one means empty: the first push moves top to index 0.
lineNotes.zh: -1 表示空：第一次压栈把 top 挪到下标 0。

lineNotes.en: After two pops the array still holds all three values, but top says only one of them is in the stack.
lineNotes.zh: 弹出两次之后，数组里三个值都还在，但 top 说栈里只剩一个。

run.expect:
Stack overflow: cannot push 40
[10, 20, 30] top = 2
30
20
[10, 20, 30] top is now 0
10
Stack underflow: nothing to pop
None
True False

blurb.en: Push every opening bracket; every closing bracket must match the one on top. Three different ways to fail, and one way to pass.
blurb.zh: 开括号一律压栈；每个闭括号都必须和栈顶那个配对。失败有三种，通过只有一种。

en: A stack remembers which brackets are still open, most recent on top. Any closing bracket has to belong to the most recently opened one - that is exactly what the top of the stack holds.
The dictionary maps each closing bracket to its opening partner, so one lookup tells you which opener a closer needs. Characters that are not brackets fall through both tests and are ignored.

There are three ways to fail. A closing bracket arrives when the stack is empty, so there is nothing for it to close. A closing bracket arrives and the opener on top is the wrong kind, as in ([)]. Or the text ends with openers still waiting on the stack, as in ((). Each failure has its own return. Only a string that survives all three is balanced.
The empty string is balanced: nothing was opened, so nothing is left unclosed.
zh: 栈记住哪些括号还开着，最近开的在最上面。任何一个闭括号都必须属于最近开的那一个——而栈顶放的恰恰就是它。
字典把每个闭括号映射到与它配对的开括号，查一次就知道这个闭括号需要哪个开括号。不是括号的字符两个判断都不满足，直接被跳过。
失败有三种。闭括号来时栈是空的，没有东西可闭。闭括号来时栈顶的开括号种类不对，比如 ([)]。或者文本读完了，栈里还有开括号在等，比如 ((。每种失败各有自己的 return。三关都过了的串才算平衡。
空串是平衡的：什么都没开，也就没有什么没闭上。

lineNotes.en: Keys are the closers, values the openers they need.
lineNotes.zh: 键是闭括号，值是它需要的开括号。

lineNotes.en: A closer with nothing open to close: the first way to fail.
lineNotes.zh: 没有开着的括号可闭：第一种失败。

run.expect:
'(a[1] + b) * {c}' True
'([)]' False
'(()' False
'())' False
'' True
'{[()()]}' True

blurb.en: In Reverse Polish Notation the operator comes after its two numbers, so one stack and one pass from left to right are enough to work out the answer.
blurb.zh: 逆波兰记法里运算符写在它的两个数后面，所以一个栈、从左到右读一遍就能算出答案。

en: Reverse Polish Notation (postfix) writes 3 + 4 as 3 4 +. It never needs brackets and never needs precedence rules: (3 + 4) * 2 is 3 4 + 2 * and 3 + 4 * 2 is 3 4 2 * +. The order of the tokens already says what happens first.
The rule is short. A number is pushed. An operator pops two numbers, combines them and pushes the result. When the tokens run out, the one number left on the stack is the answer.

The order of the two pops matters. The number popped first was pushed last, so it is the one written on the right: in 10 3 -, 3 comes off first and the answer is 10 - 3, not 3 - 10. Addition and multiplication would not notice a mix-up; subtraction and division do.

The tokens are separated by spaces, so split() cuts the expression into tokens and multi-digit numbers survive. Infix to RPN: Shunting Yard on this page goes the other way, turning ordinary infix into this notation.
zh: 逆波兰记法（后缀式）把 3 + 4 写成 3 4 +。它从来不需要括号，也不需要优先级规则：(3 + 4) * 2 是 3 4 + 2 *，3 + 4 * 2 是 3 4 2 * +。记号的先后已经说明了先算什么。
规则很短。遇到数就压栈。遇到运算符就弹出两个数，算出结果再压回去。记号读完时，栈里剩下的那一个数就是答案。
两次弹出的先后要紧。先弹出的那个数是最后压进去的，所以它是写在右边的那个：10 3 - 里先出来的是 3，答案是 10 - 3，不是 3 - 10。加法与乘法察觉不到弄反了，减法与除法会。
记号之间用空格分开，所以 split() 就能把表达式切成记号，多位数也不会被拆开。本页的「中缀转逆波兰：调度场算法」反过来，把平常的中缀式变成这种写法。

lineNotes.en: For a well-formed expression exactly one number is left: the answer.
lineNotes.zh: 合法的表达式到最后正好剩一个数：答案。

lineNotes.en: Anything that is not one of these three operators is treated as a number.
lineNotes.zh: 不是这三个运算符之一的，一律当成数。

title.zh: 中缀转逆波兰：调度场算法

blurb.en: Dijkstra's shunting-yard algorithm: numbers go straight to the output, operators wait on a stack until precedence and brackets say it is their turn.
blurb.zh: Dijkstra 的调度场算法：数直接进输出，运算符在一个栈上等着，直到优先级与括号说轮到它了。

en: Infix is the notation people write: 3 + 4 * 2, with the operator between its two numbers, precedence deciding that * goes first and brackets overriding it. The shunting-yard algorithm reads it once from left to right and writes out the same expression in Reverse Polish Notation.

Numbers go straight to the output, in the order they appear. Operators cannot, because a later operator might have to happen first; so they wait on the operator stack. When a new operator arrives, every operator on the stack that binds at least as tightly is popped to the output first, and then the new one is pushed.

At least as tightly - greater than or equal - is what makes the operators left-associative: 8 - 3 - 2 means (8 - 3) - 2, so the first minus leaves the stack before the second one is pushed. With a strict greater-than the answer would be 8 - (3 - 2).

An opening bracket is pushed and acts as a wall: the popping loop stops at it. A closing bracket pops operators to the output until it reaches the matching opening bracket, then throws that bracket away - brackets never appear in RPN. At the end, whatever is left on the stack is popped to the output. Evaluating Reverse Polish Notation on this page takes the result from here and works out its value.
zh: 中缀是人平常写的记法：3 + 4 * 2，运算符夹在两个数中间，靠优先级决定 * 先算，括号可以改写这个顺序。调度场算法从左到右读一遍，写出同一个表达式的逆波兰形式。
数直接进输出，按出现的顺序。运算符不能直接进，因为后面来的运算符可能要先算；所以它们在运算符栈上等着。新运算符来时，栈上每一个结合得至少和它一样紧的运算符先被弹到输出里，然后才把新的压进去。
「至少一样紧」——大于或等于——让运算符是左结合的：8 - 3 - 2 的意思是 (8 - 3) - 2，所以第一个减号要在第二个减号压栈之前离开栈。若写成严格的大于，结果就成了 8 - (3 - 2)。
左括号直接压栈，像一堵墙：弹栈的循环在它面前停下。右括号把运算符一个个弹到输出，直到碰到与它配对的左括号，然后把那个左括号扔掉——逆波兰里从来没有括号。最后，栈里剩下的全部弹到输出。本页的「逆波兰表达式求值」接过这里的结果，算出它的值。

lineNotes.en: A bigger number binds more tightly. Brackets are not in the table: they are handled by their own branches.
lineNotes.zh: 数越大结合得越紧。括号不在表里：它们各有自己的分支。

lineNotes.at: while ops and ops[-1] != "(" and PRECEDENCE[ops[-1]] >= PRECEDENCE[token]:
lineNotes.en: Three conditions: something is on the stack, it is not a bracket wall, and it binds at least as tightly as the new operator.
lineNotes.zh: 三个条件：栈里有东西、它不是括号那堵墙、它结合得至少和新运算符一样紧。

blurb.en: Players stand in a queue and pass the potato along; whoever holds it on the k-th count is out. A list plays the queue.
blurb.zh: 玩家排成一队传土豆，数到第 k 下时拿着土豆的人出局。用一个列表当这个队列。

en: A queue is first in, first out: people join at the back and leave from the front. A list can act as one - append joins at the back, and pop(0) leaves from the front.

Passing the potato is one person leaving the front and rejoining at the back, so the circle turns without ever being a circle. After k - 1 passes, the person at the front holds the potato on the k-th count and leaves for good. The loop repeats until nobody is left; the last one out is the winner.
The function copies names into its own list first, so the caller's list is untouched - afterwards players still holds all five names in their first order.

pop(0) works, but it is not free: after the first item goes, every item behind it has to move up one place in the list. Hot Potato with a Deque on this page swaps the list for a structure built to leave from the front.
zh: 队列是先进先出：从队尾加入，从队首离开。列表可以扮演队列——append 在队尾加入，pop(0) 从队首离开。
传一次土豆，就是一个人离开队首、重新排到队尾，于是这一圈人不必真的围成圈也能转起来。传过 k - 1 次之后，站在队首的人在第 k 下拿着土豆，永久离开。循环一直做到一个人不剩；最后出局的那个人就是赢家。
函数先把 names 复制进自己的列表，所以调用者的列表原封不动——调用之后，players 仍是原来那五个名字、原来的顺序。
pop(0) 能用，但不是白来的：第一项拿走之后，后面每一项都得在列表里往前挪一格。本页的「传土豆：双端队列」把列表换成一种专为从队首离开而造的结构。

lineNotes.en: A copy: the function never changes the list it was given.
lineNotes.zh: 一份副本：函数从不改动交给它的那个列表。

lineNotes.en: The winner is simply the last person to leave.
lineNotes.zh: 赢家就是最后离开的那个人。

run.expect:
out in order: ['Cai', 'Ana', 'Eli', 'Ben', 'Dev']
winner: Dev
players unchanged: ['Ana', 'Ben', 'Cai', 'Dev', 'Eli']
['Ana', 'Ben', 'Cai', 'Dev', 'Eli']
[]

blurb.en: The same game with collections.deque, which is made to add and remove at either end.
blurb.zh: 同一个游戏，换成 collections.deque——一种生来就能在两端增删的结构。

en: collections.deque (say "deck") is a double-ended queue from the standard library. Taking from its left end is popleft, and unlike pop(0) on a list it does not shift everything else along.

The loop has the same shape as Hot Potato with a List: k - 1 passes, each one taking the front person off the left end and putting them back on the right, then the front person leaves for good. Building the deque from names makes a new structure, so the caller's list is untouched here too.

A deque can also turn itself: rotate with a negative number moves that many items from the left end round to the right end in one call. The last lines of the demo use it: rotate(-2) on Ana, Ben, Cai, Dev, Eli gives Cai, Dev, Eli, Ana, Ben. The loop keeps to one pass at a time so it lines up with the list version.
zh: collections.deque（读作 "deck"）是标准库里的双端队列。从它的左端取东西用 popleft，而且不像列表的 pop(0)，它不会把其余元素都挪一遍。
循环与「传土豆：列表当队列」同一个样子：传 k - 1 次，每次把队首的人从左端取下、放回右端，然后队首的人永久离开。用 names 造 deque 得到的是一个新结构，所以这里调用者的列表同样原封不动。
deque 还能自己转：rotate 给一个负数，就把左端那么多项一次挪到右端。演示块最后几行用了它：对 Ana、Ben、Cai、Dev、Eli 做 rotate(-2)，得到 Cai、Dev、Eli、Ana、Ben。循环里仍然一次只传一下，好与列表版逐行对照。

lineNotes.en: deque lives in the collections module of the standard library.
lineNotes.zh: deque 在标准库的 collections 模块里。

lineNotes.en: Negative rotates to the left: the first two players move round to the back.
lineNotes.zh: 负数向左转：前两个玩家转到队尾。

run.expect:
out in order: ['Cai', 'Ana', 'Eli', 'Ben', 'Dev']
winner: Dev
['Ana', 'Ben', 'Cai', 'Dev', 'Eli']
['Ben', 'Eli', 'Ana', 'Cai', 'Dev']
deque(['Cai', 'Dev', 'Eli', 'Ana', 'Ben'])

blurb.en: A fixed-size array with front and rear pointers that wrap round to the start, and a count that says whether it is full or empty.
blurb.zh: 定长数组，front 与 rear 两个指针走到尽头就绕回开头，再加一个计数说明它是满还是空。

en: A queue in a fixed-size array needs two pointers: front, where the next item leaves, and rear, where the last item joined. If they only ever moved forward, the queue would run off the end of the array after a few operations even with free slots behind it.

The fix is to let both pointers wrap round. Adding one and taking the remainder by the capacity sends index capacity - 1 back to 0, so the array behaves like a ring. After the demo has added and removed a few items, rear sits before front in the array - the queue has wrapped.

With wrapping, front and rear alone cannot tell full from empty: in both cases they end up in the same relative place. So the queue keeps a count. A count equal to the capacity means full; a count of zero means empty. Enqueueing onto a full queue returns False and changes nothing; dequeueing from an empty one returns None.
run_ops drives the queue from a list of operations such as ("enqueue", 7) and ("dequeue",), and returns what each one gave back.
zh: 定长数组里的队列要两个指针：front 指着下一个要离开的，rear 指着最后加入的。它们要是只会往前走，几次操作之后队列就会冲出数组末尾，哪怕身后还有空格。
办法是让两个指针都绕回来。加 1 之后对容量取余，下标 capacity - 1 的下一步就回到 0，数组于是像一个环。演示块加进又取出几项之后，数组里 rear 已经在 front 前面——队列绕回来了。
一绕回，单凭 front 与 rear 就分不清满和空：两种情况下它们的相对位置一样。所以队列另记一个计数。计数等于容量就是满，计数为零就是空。往满队列入队返回 False、什么都不改；从空队列出队返回 None。
run_ops 按一张操作表驱动这个队列，表里是 ("enqueue", 7)、("dequeue",) 这样的元组，返回每个操作交回来的结果。

lineNotes.en: rear starts one before slot 0, so the first enqueue lands in slot 0.
lineNotes.zh: rear 从 0 号格的前一格开始，第一次入队正好落在 0 号格。

lineNotes.en: Here rear is before front: the queue has wrapped round the end of the array.
lineNotes.zh: 这时 rear 在 front 前面：队列已经绕过了数组末尾。

run.expect:
True True True False
1 2
True True
[5, 6, 3] front = 2 rear = 1 count = 3
3 5 6 None
[True, 7, None, True]

blurb.en: collections.deque adds and removes at both ends; given a maxlen, it quietly drops the oldest item to keep only the newest few.
blurb.zh: collections.deque 两端都能加、都能取；给了 maxlen，它就悄悄丢掉最旧的，只留最新的几项。

en: A deque has four end operations: append and pop at the right end, just like a list, plus appendleft and popleft at the left end. It can be used as a stack (one end only) or as a queue (in at one end, out at the other), or both at once.
Indexing works too: [0] is the leftmost item and [-1] the rightmost, and len counts the items.

A deque made with maxlen never grows past that length. When it is full, adding at the right silently drops the item at the left. That is exactly a recent-history list: recent_pages keeps the last few pages visited, oldest first, however many visits there were.
zh: deque 在两端共有四个操作：右端的 append 与 pop，与列表一样；左端另有 appendleft 与 popleft。它可以当栈用（只用一端），也可以当队列用（一端进、另一端出），或者两样同时用。
下标也能用：[0] 是最左边那一项，[-1] 是最右边那一项，len 数出项数。
用 maxlen 造出的 deque 永远不会超过那个长度。满了之后在右端再加一项，左端那一项就被悄悄丢掉。这正是「最近浏览记录」：recent_pages 只留最后访问的几页，最旧的在前，不管一共访问了多少次。

lineNotes.en: Turned into a list so the caller gets an ordinary Python list back.
lineNotes.zh: 转成列表，调用者拿回的是一个普通的 Python 列表。

run.expect:
deque(['a', 'b', 'c', 'd']) 4 a d
a d deque(['b', 'c'])
['sport', 'weather', 'news']
['home']

title.en: Undo and Redo with Two Stacks

blurb.en: Every edit pushes the old text onto an undo stack; undoing moves it across to a redo stack; typing something new wipes the redo stack.
blurb.zh: 每次编辑都把旧文本压进撤销栈；撤销把它挪到重做栈；新打的字会把重做栈清空。

en: An editor's undo is a stack: the most recent change is the first one undone. Before each piece of typing, the current text is pushed onto the undo stack, so popping it gives back the text as it was.

Redo needs a second stack. Undoing pushes the current text onto the redo stack before going back, and redoing does the mirror image: push the current text onto the undo stack, pop the redo stack. Undo and redo can go back and forth as often as you like.

Typing something new after an undo starts a different future, so whatever was waiting to be redone no longer makes sense: the redo stack is cleared. Undo with nothing to undo, or redo with nothing to redo, does nothing at all.
run_ops takes a list of operations such as ("type", "Hi") and ("undo",) and returns the text after every step.
zh: 编辑器的撤销是一个栈：最近的改动最先被撤销。每次打字之前，先把当前文本压进撤销栈，弹出来的就是原来的样子。
重做要第二个栈。撤销在退回之前，先把当前文本压进重做栈；重做是它的镜像：把当前文本压进撤销栈，再从重做栈弹出。撤销与重做可以来回任意多次。
撤销之后又打了新字，就开出了另一条未来，原先等着重做的东西不再有意义：重做栈被清空。没有可撤销的时候撤销、没有可重做的时候重做，都什么也不做。
run_ops 收一张操作表，表里是 ("type", "Hi")、("undo",) 这样的元组，返回每一步之后的文本。

lineNotes.en: The old text is saved before it changes.
lineNotes.zh: 在文本改变之前先存下旧文本。

lineNotes.en: Recorded after every operation, including an undo or redo that had nothing to do.
lineNotes.zh: 每个操作之后都记一次，包括什么都没做成的撤销或重做。

run.expect:
type 'Hi'
type 'Hi there'
undo 'Hi'
undo ''
undo ''
redo 'Hi'
type 'Hi!'
redo 'Hi!'
undo 'Hi'

blurb.en: New items go onto one stack; when the other stack runs dry, the first is poured across, which turns the order round.
blurb.zh: 新来的压到一个栈上；另一个栈空了，就把第一个栈整个倒过去——一倒，顺序就翻过来了。

en: A stack reverses order, and reversing twice gives back the original order. That is the whole trick: items are pushed onto inbox as they arrive; to dequeue, items are popped from outbox, which holds them in reverse, so the oldest is on top.

The pouring happens only when outbox is empty. Pouring while outbox still held something would bury its older items under newer ones. In the demo, when 4 joins, 2 and 3 are still in outbox, so 4 waits in inbox until they have left.

Each item is poured across at most once in its life: pushed onto inbox once, poured into outbox once, popped off outbox once. That does not mean most dequeues pour nothing - when enqueues and dequeues take turns, every dequeue finds outbox empty and pours the one item that just arrived. Dequeueing when both stacks are empty returns None.
run_ops drives the queue from a list of operations such as ("enqueue", 5) and ("dequeue",), and returns what each dequeue gave back.
zh: 栈会把顺序倒过来，倒两次就回到原来的顺序。整个诀窍就在这里：来一项就压进 inbox；出队时从 outbox 弹，outbox 里的顺序是反的，最早来的那一项正在顶上。
只有 outbox 空了才倒。outbox 里还有东西时就倒，会把它更早的那些项压在更新的项下面。演示块里 4 加入时，2 和 3 还在 outbox 里，所以 4 在 inbox 里等，直到它们离开。
每一项一生至多被倒过去一次：压进 inbox 一次、倒进 outbox 一次、从 outbox 出队一次。但这不是说大多数出队都不用倒——入队与出队交替进行时，每次出队都碰上 outbox 是空的，要把刚进来的那一项倒过去。两个栈都空时出队返回 None。
run_ops 按一张操作表驱动队列，表里是 ("enqueue", 5)、("dequeue",) 这样的元组，返回每次出队交回来的结果。

lineNotes.en: Enqueueing never touches outbox.
lineNotes.zh: 入队从不碰 outbox。

lineNotes.en: 2 and 3 are still waiting in outbox, so 4 goes into inbox and stays there until they have left.
lineNotes.zh: 2 和 3 还在 outbox 里等着，所以 4 进 inbox，一直待到它们离开。
